title: indiek — Music from Korea, worth sharing
description: Hear Korean bands and solo artists through recordings and live performances, with stories about the music and the people who make it.

features.title: First love, in Baek A’s words.
features.deck: Baek A performs Amor live for MONTBEST, with a poetic English adaptation to read alongside the song.

features.title: Hoping to be remembered.
features.deck: YdBB’s ONCE is about letting someone go, with the hope that they’ll remember you kindly.

features.title: From the band’s early days.
features.deck: Don’t feel sad is an early WhiteUsedSocks song, written and composed by Jung Jaeheon.

features.title: Motte’s song for A-TEEN.
features.deck: Motte sang Don’t run away for the web drama. The song has a place here whether or not you’ve seen it.

features.title: Getting through the day.
features.deck: In Even if you leave, HANRORO writes about letting go and the blame we turn on ourselves.

features.title: A love song from TEAM BABY.
features.deck: EVERYTHING came out on its own before becoming part of The Black Skirts’ TEAM BABY.

features.title: Run with Me, on stage.
features.deck: sunwoojunga sings a song from Serenade at the concert of the same name.

features.title: Tree, in an Open Mic session.
features.deck: Car, the garden performs Tree for the official Begin Again Open Mic series.

features.title: A place to belong.
features.deck: In Forest, Choi Yu Ree finds an image for belonging in trees growing together. Here she sings it live.

features.title: Eternal love, live at Bloom.
features.deck: Ahn Ji-young brings a song from Merry Go Round to BOL4’s 2024 Bloom concert.

features.title: Romance, youth, love.
features.deck: An early ESEGYE song, recorded at the band’s first BLIND concert at Veloso Hongdae.

features.title: The Wave keeps going.
features.deck: SE SO NEON’s The Wave stretches into a long instrumental ending in this 2020/NEON performance.

features.title: Guitar, voice and Breath.
features.deck: Breath is an acoustic R&B song about the little reminders left after a breakup.

features.title: Yerin Baek’s 0310.
features.deck: Yerin Baek sings 0310 in English, with lyrics on screen in her own video. The song is from Every letter I sent you.

Korean artists and songs I wish more people knew.
I add to the selection as I find more music to share.
I hope you find something you like.
